functions.name: VALUE
functions.description: A company's figure from its SEC filings, as Tributary reads it. #N/A says why when there is no number to show (stale, n/m, another currency).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: A metric name: revenue, net_income, gross_margin, eps_diluted...

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: latest (default), TTM, FY, FY2024, FY2024 Q3, CY2024 Q3, a quarter's end day, or TTM before a quarter.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: A past day: the figure as it stood at its end, from the filings filed by then.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency you accept (default USD). Tributary never converts.

functions.name: SERIES
functions.description: A company's figures for its newest periods, oldest first: the period and the figure on each row (spills).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: A metric name: revenue, net_income, gross_margin, eps_diluted...

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency you accept (default USD). Tributary never converts.

functions.name: SOURCE
functions.description: Where a figure comes from: its filing on EDGAR, or another field (period, filed, form, accession, unit, status, reason).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: A metric name: revenue, net_income, gross_margin, eps_diluted...

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: url (default), period, period_end, filed, form, accession, unit, status or reason.
